notices.title: Welcome to the Official Ebenezer H.S. School App
notices.body: All students, teachers, class teachers, principal and administrative staff can now access their dashboards, check official announcements, and communicate securely via the School Group.

notices.title: Term Assessment & Attendance Submission Reminder
notices.body: Class Teachers are requested to verify class lists. Students should check the Notices board regularly for upcoming assessment schedules and holiday updates.
